codetemplate.code: FROM ${table} SELECT ${cols default="*"} ${cursor};
SELECT * EXCLUDE (${cols}) FROM ${table}${cursor};
SELECT * REPLACE (${expr} AS ${col}) FROM ${table}${cursor};
SELECT ${agg default="min"}(COLUMNS('${regex default=".*"}')) FROM ${table}${cursor};
PIVOT ${table} ON ${column} USING ${agg default="sum"}(${value}) GROUP BY ${group}${cursor};
UNPIVOT ${table} ON ${columns} INTO NAME ${name default="name"} VALUE ${value default="value"}${cursor};
SELECT * FROM read_csv('${path}', header = true, auto_detect = true)${cursor};
SELECT * FROM read_parquet('${path}')${cursor};
SELECT * FROM read_json_auto('${path}')${cursor};
COPY (${query}) TO '${path}' (FORMAT parquet)${cursor};

codetemplate.descriptionId: CREATE TABLE AS from a file
codetemplate.code: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE ${table} AS SELECT * FROM '${path}'${cursor};
CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO ${name}(${params}) AS ${expr}${cursor};
CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO ${name}(${params}) AS TABLE ${query}${cursor};
SELECT list_transform(list_filter(${list}, x -> ${pred default="x IS NOT NULL"}), x -> ${expr default="x"})${cursor};
SELECT {'${a default="a"}': ${va default="1"}, '${b default="b"}': ${vb default="'x'"}} AS s, s.${a}${cursor};
SELECT ${id}, unnest(${list}) AS ${elem default="elem"} FROM ${table}${cursor};

codetemplate.descriptionId: Inline rows with VALUES (no file needed)

codetemplate.code: SELECT * FROM ${table} USING SAMPLE ${pct default="10"}% (bernoulli, ${seed default="42"})${cursor};
SUMMARIZE ${table}${cursor};
DESCRIBE SELECT * FROM ${source}${cursor};
EXPLAIN ANALYZE ${query}${cursor};
INSTALL ${ext}; LOAD ${ext};${cursor}
ATTACH '${path}' AS ${name} (READ_ONLY); SELECT * FROM ${name}.main.${table}${cursor};
CREATE OR REPLACE SECRET ${name default="s3"} (TYPE s3, KEY_ID '${key}', SECRET '${secret}', REGION '${region default="eu-west-1"}')${cursor};
SELECT ${cols}, sum(${value}) OVER (PARTITION BY ${key} ORDER BY ${order} ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running_total FROM ${table}${cursor};
